divisions.title: Formation
divisions.summary: Joshua takes command; Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground and camps at Gilgal.

divisions.title: First Tests
divisions.summary: Jericho collapses; Achan’s hidden sin brings defeat at Ai, then victory after honesty.

divisions.title: Possess
divisions.summary: The Gibeonite trick, the sun stands still, and the kings of the land fall.

divisions.title: Inheritance
divisions.summary: The land east of the Jordan is confirmed, Caleb claims Hebron, and Judah and the sons of Joseph receive their portions.

divisions.title: Shiloh
divisions.theme: The rest of the land divided
divisions.summary: At the tent of meeting the remaining seven tribes are surveyed and given their lots; cities of refuge and Levite towns are set apart.

divisions.title: Legacy
divisions.summary: Joshua’s farewell: "as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD."
